objective: perform the single untouched confirmation of the GSE96583 classifier after GSE164378-only uncertainty calibration, using the paper-linked processed count matrix and cell metadata for the independent Stanford GSE150728 cohort

prior_source_failures.reason: exact frozen donor and condition column aliases did not admit the released headers
the frozen donor alias list did not admit the released plural Patients header

confirmation_source.paper: Wilk et al., Nature Medicine 2020, PMID 32514174
confirmation_source.paper_data_availability: processed count matrices with de-identified metadata and embeddings are distributed through the COVID-19 Cell Atlas and the public CZ CELLxGENE dataset
confirmation_source.official_design_known_before_asset_acces: 44,721 PBMC cells from seven hospitalized COVID-19 patients and six healthy controls

h5ad_axis_contract.cell_type_column_resolution: first exact normalized match among celltype, celltypel1, majorcelltype, authorcelltype, annotation; normalization is Unicode casefold followed by deletion of non-ASCII-alphanumeric characters and removal of a single trailing s
h5ad_axis_contract.donor_column_resolution: first exact normalized match among donor, donorid, patient, patientid, individual, individualid, subject, subjectid, sample, sampleid; the same normalization and singularization apply
h5ad_axis_contract.condition_column_resolution: first exact normalized match among disease, diseasestatus, condition, group, status, studyclassification, sampletype; the same normalization and singularization apply
h5ad_axis_contract.matrix_acceptance: selected matrix must be sparse or dense nonnegative integer-valued counts; refuse normalized nonintegers

population_contract.primary_population: cells whose author/paper-linked condition is normal or healthy control

expression_contract.normalization: per-cell library size to 10000 followed by log1p
expression_contract.gene_alignment: exact case-sensitive HGNC symbol intersection in the fixed 508-feature order
expression_contract.duplicate_gene_symbols: use first released row in source order and report

failure_policy.any_primary_endpoint_failure: retain blocked_external_uncertainty and permanently retire this asset from pristine use
failure_policy.success: promote only the PBMC context head to externally uncertainty-validated pre-sweep ranking; numeric Aleph ranges remain forbidden
